scope: Full pretrained 1,448,176,770-parameter Show-o Transformer; frozen MagViT; small-data fine-tuning and held-out teacher-forced evaluation, not paper-scale training
prerequisite: Full-model MMU and T2I loss/all-parameter gradient validation; numerical failures must be reviewed before training

data.selection: First 32 train images and first 8 validation images in the existing verified manifest order; persist explicit image IDs and hashes before execution
data.tokenizer: Pinned local Phi tokenizer with official UniversalPrompting special tokens
data.overlap_policy: Reject duplicate image hashes and train/validation overlap

training.initial_weights: Identical official pretrained checkpoint for both frameworks
training.trainable_parameters: All 437 Transformer tensors; no LoRA or frozen Transformer layers
training.optimizer_step_loss: Mean of one MMU microbatch loss and one T2I microbatch loss; microbatch size 1; sequential gradient accumulation
training.t2i_masking: Exactly 512 of 1024 image codes selected by a persisted NumPy seed schedule; identical masks and sample order across frameworks
training.logging: Per-task losses, learning rate, gradient norm, elapsed time, peak GPU memory, nonfinite checks; compare per-step curves without requiring bitwise identical optimization trajectories
training.checkpoint_policy: Preserve original pretrained weights; final new weights-only checkpoints with reload validation; no claim of exact optimizer/RNG resume
training.advance_policy: Measure 10 steps and evaluate stability/resources before the 100-step run; no automatic full run on failed or nonfinite calibration

evaluation.mmu: Teacher-forced shifted full-vocabulary CE and token accuracy on nonignored caption labels
evaluation.t2i: Unshifted official prompting CE; separately report token accuracy/CE for masked image positions at fixed 50% mask and all-image-mask settings
evaluation.aggregation: Sum CE over supervised tokens / total supervised tokens; accuracy uses the same declared token denominator; report task and mask setting separately
evaluation.comparison: Both frameworks on the exact same persisted held-out fixtures before and after fine-tuning; publish absolute metric differences and sample counts
evaluation.metric_limits: Eight-image validation subset and teacher-forced token metrics do not establish paper-level FID, CLIPScore or open-ended understanding performance
evaluation.expansion: Choose a published generation/understanding benchmark protocol, dataset size and evaluator versions before any larger evaluation; FID and CLIPScore are not claimed in this pilot
